name: Tessaplay
title: Angular lettering and ornament
description: A narrow decorative display face with angular flared terminals and a dot-and-wedge rhythm. Its energetic pen-drawn voice suits cultural programs, editorial titles and event identities.
story: Jokerman inspired the interplay of lettering and ornament. The selected original OpenAI B alphabet was traced with protected details and optically spaced. Explicitly authored companions extend its repertoire. Version 0.024 corrects mixed-mark contextual dot removal, including an exact native-contour dotless-ogonek alternate. The selected alphabet and ordinary i/j remain intact.
independent_review: Current final package cleared in integration handoff
distribution_terms: Pending owner review. No redistribution license is assigned to these sample font assets. The repository compiler license is unchanged.
build_boundary: The final 354-scalar assembly includes an explicit fontTools artifact step after the compiler-valid ordinary source. A full final-assembly stock CLI preflight/release pass is not claimed. Producer source-stage checks and final-binary validation remain separate.
limitations: Display use from 48px; body text and smaller sizes are not certified.
Exact listed coverage and documented language/one- or two-mark samples only. Arbitrary accent stacks, every Latin orthography and every rendering engine are not certified.
Static Regular TTF/WOFF2 only; no CFF OTF, variable axes or additional styles.
j + U+0326 + U+0301 reaches y=-363: 13 units below the typographic descender of -350.
Q + two U+0326 marks reaches -428: 78 units below the descender; this stress case has no supported-fit claim.
Keep adequate line height and avoid clipping containers. Numerals 2–5 and signs are simpler companions and remain an aesthetic choice.
